security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, TypeScript examples, environment variable documentation, and relative imports. One real issue remains: references/testing.md line 282 recommends a remote curl pipe-to-shell installer. No prompt injection or hidden data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Remote installer piped directly to bash
remediation.suggestion: Replace the Maestro install example with an official package manager command, a pinned release, or a checksum-verified manual install path.

content.user_title: Build React Native and Expo Apps
content.value_statement: React Native projects require many platform decisions across navigation, state, builds, and testing. This skill provides concise Expo-first patterns for production mobile development.
actual_capabilities: Guides Expo Router layouts, dynamic routes, tabs, stacks, modals, links, and sheets.
Recommends UI components, image handling, lists, safe areas, native controls, and visual effects.
Covers Zustand, Jotai, React Query, React Hook Form, and Zod patterns.
Explains API clients, auth tokens, server routes, webhooks, and environment variable boundaries.
Provides performance guidance for FlashList, bundle size, startup time, memory, and animations.
Covers Jest, React Native Testing Library, Maestro, EAS builds, SDK upgrades, and CI workflows.
limitations: It provides guidance, not a complete project scaffold.
Examples may need updates for your Expo SDK, React Native version, and library versions.
It cannot verify device performance, native module compatibility, or store compliance without project context.
Remote installer commands should be reviewed before running.

use_cases.title: Start an Expo App
use_cases.description: Create a new Expo project with routing, common dependencies, path aliases, and a clean folder structure.

use_cases.title: Improve App Quality
use_cases.description: Add forms, API state, accessibility-focused tests, offline handling, and validation patterns to an existing app.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Release
use_cases.description: Plan performance checks, EAS build profiles, submissions, CI workflows, and SDK upgrade work.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New Expo App
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a new Expo app. Include routing, folder structure, core dependencies, environment variables, and first screens.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Validated Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a React Native form for this feature. Use React Hook Form, Zod, accessible fields, and clear submit error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design the Data Layer
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my app data needs. Recommend React Query, Zustand, Jotai, secure token storage, API routes, and offline behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize and Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Expo app for release. Cover performance profiling, bundle size, EAS build profiles, tests, CI, and upgrade risks.

output_examples.input: Plan a new task tracker app in Expo.
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan with Expo Router screens, shared components, state boundaries, API client setup, and release checklist.

output_examples.input: Improve a slow product catalog screen.
output_examples.output: A performance review that recommends FlashList, memoized rows, deferred search updates, bundle checks, and profiling steps.

output_examples.input: Prepare a checkout flow for testing.
output_examples.output: A test plan covering form validation, mocked API failures, navigation paths, E2E flows, and store state reset patterns.

best_practices: Read the relevant reference file before changing navigation, networking, forms, testing, or releases.
Keep secrets server-side and expose only public Expo variables to client bundles.
Measure performance in release-like builds before making optimization decisions.
anti_patterns: Using FlatList or ScrollView for large datasets without checking FlashList patterns.
Putting components, utilities, or shared types inside Expo Router route folders.
Running remote installer scripts without reviewing the source, version, and verification path.

faq.question: Does this skill create a full React Native app?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and implementation guidance that an agent can apply inside your project.

faq.question: Does it support Expo Router?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes route conventions, stacks, tabs, links, modals, sheets, and server routes.

faq.question: Can it help with forms and validation?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers React Hook Form, Zod schemas, reusable fields, multi-step forms, and form tests.

faq.question: Does it cover app performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers profiling, FlashList, render reduction, startup time, bundle size, memory, and animation rules.

faq.question: Can it help with releases?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers EAS build profiles, submit commands, over-the-air updates, SDK upgrades, and CI workflows.

faq.question: Should agents run every command automatically?
faq.answer: No. Review install, build, submit, and remote script commands before allowing execution.
